name: puzzlebox
description: Agent-first backend framework for daily-play games

scripts.build: npm run build -w @puzzlebox/shared && npm run build -w @puzzlebox/sdk && npm run build -w @puzzlebox/db && npm run build -w @puzzlebox/api && npm run build -w @puzzlebox/web && npm run build -w @puzzlebox/sheets-sync
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/shared && npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/db && npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/api && npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/web && npm run typecheck -w @puzzlebox/sheets-sync
